purpose: Six predeclared contrasts of ALL15 vs single-group observation, using one binary per stage
numeric_requirement: 4096 unique dyadic output values independently checked exactly per target; padding/nonfinite errors rejected. Not full-D verification.
trace_requirement: Mode-specific mask/count, group2/group16 interval containment; full early Q/R only in ALL15; all other missing components stay None.
stopping: Exactly 96 targets, retain and stop on any numerical/format/SM check failure; no replacement, extension or partial scoring.
prefix: Each target in a fresh process, sixteen same-buffer calls of that stage binary with observer0.
performance_decision: Instrumented bundle feedback only; no equivalence, no uninstrumented Q, no service price or model acceptance.
scope_preserved: Development cfg_b probe only; full cfg_a/b/c prediction objective unchanged.
GPU_allocation: a058 exclusive; actual four GPUs/288 CPUs, one serial target stream.

randomization.method: independent uniform permutation of six arms within each block

inference.target: separate medians of six jointly formed block contrasts
inference.method: exact binomial rank3..14 of 16, Bonferroni for six predeclared quantities
inference.assumption: IID block contrast vectors, not established by randomized order
